title: Publish and consume bounded European dynamic raw transfer fragments
changes: Publish a separately authenticated managed resource for seven bounded dynamic selector and bank fragments and compose typed bus reads with existing owners without limiting guest selectors.
validation: Windows test build and one corrected focused Wine test pass 1304 source bytes, boundary reads, prior-owner composition, one DMA16 complete-state/clock comparison and altered-resource rejection; guarded ROM, old dataset and sources unchanged.

The first Wine attempt found a missing final-bank source page, corrected before the passing retry; a full disk was relieved using the retention helper on a previously completed unit and relocated executables were restored.
limitations: Production CLI, original dynamic routine and native execution, positive ordinary use and the global selector domain remain open; Linux, USA and native Windows checks are pending. No performance measurement.
